action.command:
for p in 18000 18001 18002 18003 18005 18006 18007 18010 18011 18012 18013 18014 18015 18016 18020 18024; do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 5 http://localhost:$p/health 2>/dev/null)
  code2=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 5 http://localhost:$p/healthz 2>/dev/null)
  code3=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 5 http://localhost:$p/ 2>/dev/null)
  echo "port $p  /health=$code  /healthz=$code2  /=$code3"
done
